data.title: Unit 6 : Matter and materials
Atoms and molecules
data.text: Click on either True or False for the following sentences.
It is possible to change matter from one form to another.
Liquids can be turned into solid by boiling them.
Some solids can be melted into liquids by heating.
When a liquid is boiled, its molecules starts moving closer to each other.
Molecules in a solid can move freely and quickly.

feedback.rank1: Hmm... You can do better than this.
